description.txt: Starts the skills with slash commands, watches the worker runs in the progress panes, and answers the questions of the agents.
A Claude Code or Codex session that loads the skill plugins, follows a skill step by step, and runs the tools and the fleet CLIs that it names.
The skills layer of the 21Stark fleet: 31 skills in seven Claude Code plugins, the TypeScript tools that they call, three hooks and four mods, served from source as a Claude Code marketplace.
The ticket CLI of the fleet: binds a ticket to a session, and reads, files and moves the ClickUp tickets.
Places the tabs of the agents in cmux, carries their messages, and closes the tabs.
Holds njord, which opens and merges the PRs, and valkyrie, which launches the Gru, Minion and Agnes workers.
The local registry of the fleet: tells a launcher the folder of each repo on the Mac.
Carries messages between agents. A Gru with a muninn leader reports to the chief of odin through it.
The vendor CLI of the fleet: reads and writes the EI tickets in the Jira of Evinced, and sends rich text to Slack and Jira.
The second-brain engine. Its brain adr commands record and supersede the ADRs of a repo.
Sends a push from the Mac to the iPhone, the iPad and the Watch of the operator.
The code graveyard of the fleet: a git repo that keeps the retired code, one row for each burial in its index.
Keeps the C4 model of each product as LikeC4 text, builds its views, and shows the proposals in its studio.
Drives Chrome for agents. Its Huginn route draws boxes with questions on a page of the operator.
Hosts the repos, the PRs, the reviews and the releases, and serves this repo as the plugin marketplace.
The claude, codex and gemini CLIs, which run headless as reviewers, as a jury, or as a test of a skill description.
The vault of the fleet facts that every session reads. Its entity folders name the repos of the fleet.

summary.txt: The 31 skills in seven plugins, which a coding agent loads and follows.

description.txt: Hold the procedures that a coding agent follows: tickets, specs, builds, reviews, sessions, releases, the Gru, Minion and Agnes workers, and the docs, writing and design skills. Claude Code installs them from the marketplace manifest; Codex reads the same tree.

summary.txt: Start Claude, Codex and Gemini as headless reviewers and merge their findings.

description.txt: iac_review, refactor_planner and jury start Claude, Codex and Gemini as headless subprocesses with a scrubbed environment, then parse and merge their output. preflight checks the agents and the logins first.
Posts the findings of a code review on a PR as one review: inline where the anchor is in the diff, in the body otherwise, and never twice.
copilot_land pushes the branch of a build and opens or adopts its PR, validation_gate runs the checks of a repo, and approach_contract and github_projects support the build.

summary.txt: Open, close and hand over sessions, and run the health checks and the self-heal.

description.txt: stark_session opens and closes a session with its health checks and briefing; stark_handover, session_state, context_compactor and stark_persona keep its state; self_healer and healer_canary fix known failures; asset_links installs the checkout links.

summary.txt: Audit the agent docs, the skills and the memory notes, and measure the asks.

description.txt: rules_audit triages the agent instruction files clause by clause, memory_tidy tidies the auto-memory, ask_guard_metric counts the turns that end on a question, and the skill tools audit and tune the skills.
release_changelog drafts the changelog of a release from the git history, and release_version_bump picks and writes the next version.
Runs before each njord pr-merge call, triages the agent files that the PR changes, and denies the merge only on a RED clause that the PR adds.
Runs after each write to an auto-memory file, and tells the session when the fact may belong in the ecosystem vault instead.
Runs on each stop of a session, counts the model turns of the main agent in the transcript, and asks a long session to tell the librarian its lasting facts.

summary.txt: Shows a live board of each Gru run and a pane of each worker ticket.

description.txt: Shows the Gru pane and the ticket pane beside the chat: the board of a run, its log in plain words, its stats, and the settings that the workers read before a review, a merge or a release.

summary.txt: Let the operator answer the questions of the agent in a band or a pane.

description.txt: needs-you shows the Needs you lines of a turn in a band above the prompt; decision-deck and interview give the agent the present and ask tools, and show the questions in a pane.
The ticket, run, log and settings files in ~/.cache/stark-progress: the state contract between the worker skills and the stark-progress mod.
The session files, the handovers, the healer log, the jury runs, the ask-guard log and the tell-on-stop counts in ~/.claude/code-review, outside the plugin cache, so that they outlive an update.
